signature: soak.open_fds=+8 (budget +5) after 15,142 turns; the same binary and flags measured +0 on the next run
evidence: Windows GetProcessHandleCount mixes threads, Winsock events and pooled connections into platform bookkeeping. Added http.ConnState counting to the fixture: 15,760 turns showed opened=927 closed=927 retained=1 (the single idle connection left by warmup). Gates are now soak.connections_reclaimed (retained <= max_active_connections, default 8) and a steady-state soak.open_fds (second half of the window only); the total handle delta and per-second series stay in the report as trend data. report unit tests cover both a settling series and a growing one.
